source.source_revision: Wahapedia Space Marines App 2.8.1 / October 2026; stable Last_update 2026-10-19 03:47:32; live page checked 2026-10-27.
source.game_mode: Standard Warhammer 40,000 11th edition through the local match/action runtime; this is not full-match certification.
source.chapter_context: Shared-book Salamanders Character profile. Chapter roster restrictions and Chapter-specific effects remain outside this local datasheet scope.

fixed_data_comparison.scope: The per-profile comparison reports no fixed-data differences for identity, numeric profile, keywords, fixed loadout, composition, base and cost. The parent comparator is not globally certified because of unrelated export structural errors; this check does not certify executable rules behavior.

local_scope_validation.command: python tools/verify.py --godot .tools/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe --profile targeted --only test_vulkan_hestan --only test_vulkan_hestan_profile_parity --only test_space_marine_leader_links --timeout 300

scope: Exact one-model 105-point profile, source characteristics/keywords, 40 mm base, fixed Bolt Pistol, Gauntlet of the Forge and Spear of Vulkan; verified zero equipment-option rows.
All three source-listed weapon profiles route through Equipment and AttackPlan, including Close-Quarters, Torrent and Devastating Wounds.

Both players materialize from current Space Marines catalogs; one-copy admission is checked. All five common-book Leader targets are accepted through the 153-link relation regression; an unlisted Intercessor target is rejected. The Legends Vanguard Veteran pairing is excluded.
Combat Doctrines and Transhuman Strategist: Warlord selection and once-per-round CP are checked.

Vulkan has the source Feel No Pain 6+ through the shared prevention resolver; Seeker of the Unfound selects an objective after deployment and conditionally grants OC 10, Leadership 5+ and Feel No Pain 4+ while in objective range, then restores his base profile after leaving.

Forgefather is selected once in Vulkan’s Shooting phase against one visible enemy within 24 inches. Melta and Torrent attacks gain +2 Strength only against that target for the phase; the test covers visible/range/opaque-terrain rejection, Eradicator Melta and Vulkan’s actual Torrent AttackPlans, and an unmarked target.
The normalized Seeker deployment decision checks owner and stale-option rejection without mutation and preserves its decision across save/restore.
limits: The fixed-data comparator reports no Vulkan profile differences, but its global full_match_certified field is false because the parent export has unrelated structural errors; the profile comparison is not a full rules certificate.
The run is local and offline (network=false); network validation remains deferred to final integration.

This closes Vulkan’s common-book local datasheet scope only. Salamanders Chapter rules, Vanguard Veteran Legends pairing, cross-sheet list legality, full army legality, complete matches and human playtesting are outside this scope.
